description: Participating individually in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, developing an interactive 3D Orbital Debris simulation and cleanup game using Antigravity, Three.js, and JavaScript. Passionate about space exploration, astrophysics, and web-based visualization to tackle space junk challenges.
summary:
Project Title: Project Orbital Scavengers
​Project Summary:
"Project Orbital Scavengers" is an interactive browser-based arcade and space mission simulation game designed to address the critical challenge of orbital debris management and sustainable space exploration. Developed using JavaScript, the Phaser 3 framework, and the Web Audio API, the application simulates real-world orbital mechanics, satellite telemetry tracking, and debris mitigation strategies.
​Key Features & Technologies:
​Interactive Mission Simulation: Tracks active satellites and orbital debris fields in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) to promote awareness of space congestion.
​Debris Removal Tools: Features simulated orbital tools including a Lidar Scanner, Ion Ablation Laser, Magnetic Harpoon, and Drag Sail de-orbit mechanisms.
​Modern Web Standards: Built with lightweight web technologies ensuring smooth local and hosted deployment.
​This project combines educational space science concepts with engaging interactive gameplay to highlight the importance of cleaning up Earth's orbital environment.
